profile.headline: Senior Frontend Engineer
profile.summary:
As a frontend engineer, my focus is always to put people first. I am deeply committed to creating optimal user experiences that help people achieve their goals and improve their lives. 

With a background spanning healthtech, edtech, and more, I have honed my skills in designing new apps, features, internal tools, and design systems that prioritize the needs of our users and teams. By drawing inspiration from my love of art and problem solving, I use creative solutions to build the best possible user experience that makes it easier for other people to achieve their goals and focus on what matters to them most.
